description: This file defines the QueryDisplayDriver class, which manages display, editing, and updating of Query objects within the OrchardCore framework. It handles rendering query details, editing forms, and validation logic for query names and schemas.

classes.name: QueryDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver class for rendering, editing, and updating Query objects within OrchardCore.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Renders the display view of a Query object, showing summary information.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Prepares the editing view for a Query object.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Validates and updates a Query object based on user input, including name and schema validation.
